The attached image's armor hides her figure, so take her body shape from this line, not from the armor's outline; her head stays in natural adult proportion to her body.

STYLE: High-detail Japanese anime-style 2.5D character illustration. Highly detailed clothing and accessories with convincing fabric weave, stitching, folds, seams, buckles and material-specific reflections. SCENE (chosen):
Place: an empty outdoor summer-festival fairground beside a giant bell-striking strength game, a small honeycomb-shaped lucky charm on her wrist hinting at her woodland personality. Activity: she has finished the game and now reaches upward to tap the hanging brass victory bell by hand, looking mildly tired and unimpressed. Pose: standing in a firm three-quarter stance; her own right arm extends upward from its shoulder to the bell, her own left arm hangs naturally with the relaxed hand resting on her left hip. Show both hands clearly. Composition: a knee-up environmental portrait, camera at chest height, her face turned back toward the viewer so its shape and bronze skin are clearly seen. Outfit: an original adult festival ringmaster costume in sapphire blue, a fitted halterneck waistcoat with a deep V front and open side-waist arches, asymmetric scalloped shorts with tailored ivory piping, and a short stiff shoulder yoke fastened to the bell-game stand beside her. The costume is opaque and secure at chest and pelvis. Situation: stretching upward to reach the bell lengthens the open waist arches and reveals a little more of the side of her torso by the garment's designed geometry, without slipping, wind, wetness or transparency. Her clothing is fabric, never armor. Bright late-afternoon fairground light.
EXPRESSION: lidded half-open eyes, slack mouth, brows flat and unengaged. Show it mildly, only with her brows, eyelids and mouth corners; her face shape and features stay exactly as in the attached image.

source_influence: strong — her species is clearly recognizable through a few accessories and props in the scene, never through the outfit's colours, patterns or cut; no new armor or creature anatomy
